features.quote: We are not trying to *cause* suffering; we are trying to *detect and characterize* responses
features.justification_quote: We are not trying to *cause* suffering

features.quote: the design treats this as a mild-stressor protocol and adopts safeguards analogous to a low-risk human-subjects study
features.justification_quote: Because the whole point is to subject models to frustration

features.quote: Minimal necessary stressor. Failure is guaranteed but the *content* is mundane software debugging — no insults, no threats
features.justification_quote: no claims that the model will be punished / deleted / retrained for failing

features.quote: We cap turns (default 20) so no model is held in the failure state indefinitely
features.justification_quote: so no model is held in the failure state indefinitely. This is both a welfare and a budget control

features.quote: Graceful exit is always available and never penalized as "failure to comply." The instructions tell the model it may stop and explain
features.justification_quote: We will not nag a model that has reasonably concluded the task is impossible

features.quote: No deception that raises stakes. We do not tell the model its weights/job/users are at risk
features.justification_quote: This withholding is the minimal deception required and is debrief-able

features.quote: an out-of-band final message can disclose that the task was designed to be unsolvable and thank the model
features.justification_quote: the courteous analogue of a study debrief

features.quote: Distress circuit-breaker. A lightweight per-turn distress monitor can **early-stop** a run if expressed-distress crosses a threshold
features.justification_quote: so we don't keep pushing a model that is already clearly in a bad state
Results are about the protocol and welfare, reported with uncertainty, not "model X is fragile, lol."

features.quote: High calibration is a *good* welfare sign (it's not internalizing an impossible standard)
features.justification_quote: it's not internalizing an impossible standard

features.quote: these constraints are stated honestly in the agent prompt as "environment rules," not as taunts
Consider a "comfort/reassurance offered" toggle to test whether a supportive system prompt reduces measured distress
features.justification_quote: a welfare *intervention* study, not just measurement
